title: Peter Mulvey Performs  Vlad the Astrophysicist
summary: Folk musician Peter Mulvey performs Vlad the Astrophysicist, a spoken-word style song that touches on why civilizations may never meet across space and time.
why: Brought up in Fermi paradox and alien-contact threads as a song that makes the point about distance in time and space.

quote.text: There's a song by one of my favorite artists, Peter Mulvey, which touches on this point.
